sections.heading: Coralogix limitation, pricing interpretation, and alternative context
sections.body:
Limitation: Does not outrank Datadog (8.6); No published seat floor — GB/token math still dominates TCO; 14-day / 8-unit trial is not a free forever plan because it forces process changes or add-ons around Coralogix when incident management is the job.

Pricing interpretation: no free plan confirmed — scope a paid pilot on Pay-as-you-go rate card with exit criteria before annual seats.

Plan trade-off: you gain incident management at the expense of Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models — measure both in the pilot. Researched packaging: Pay-as-you-go rate card · incident management | Committed usage.

Alternative context: unlike Datadog, Coralogix is preferable when Teams that want a published per-GB observability card instead of host SKUs because incident management plus incident management match; prefer Datadog when SRE teams buying Datadog infrastructure monitoring as the award path because the operating loops differ.

sections.body:
